title: Grateful Dead Live at Cobo Arena on 1977-11-01
lineage: SBD> Master (Betty Board) Reels> PCM> DAT> CDR> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear Betty Board captures a blistering fall‑'77 second set – smoking Jerry, tight Keith, and soaring Truckin', Estimated→Other One→Wharf Rat jams.
ai_review.review: The recording is a top‑notch soundboard (Betty) with crisp clarity; only a minor reel‑flip on Truckin' is noted. Musically the show bursts with energy – the second set’s heavy chugging, fiery Truckin', explosive Estimated→Other One→Wharf Rat sequence and standout performances of Terrapin Station, The Music Never Stopped and U.S. Blues earn high praise from fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Over a dozen detailed reviews consistently give 4‑5 stars, praising both the superb soundboard quality and the high‑energy performance; minor glitches are few.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, balanced Betty Board with very good overall fidelity. A single reel‑flip glitch on Truckin' is mentioned, but no significant dropouts or muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set described as a high‑octane, chugging marathon with seamless transitions (Terrapin→Estimated→Other One→Drums→Wharf Rat) and an overall hot, energetic flow that keeps the audience on fire.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s playing is repeatedly called “smoking,” “on fire,” and a highlight of the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s keyboards are praised for great tone, tightness, and unusual harmonics that stand out in the jam sections.
